# Creator Project fixtures

`creator-soundset-acceptance.lmdj` is a small, valid `lmdj.project-bundle.v1`
fixture for local Creator acceptance. It contains one imported kick sample
assigned to Bank A, Pad 1, so the Creator can be opened without first creating
a Project.

In Creator, choose **Import .lmdj** on the Project surface and select this file.
After import, activate audio and open **Sound Sets** to browse the local test
Catalog.
